import trimesh
ov=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/overlap-jar-0163-lid-98fb.stl')
print('ov bounds',ov.bounds,'vol',ov.volume,'area',ov.area)
# sample: where is overlap centroid
print('centroid',ov.centroid)
# instances
jar=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.caabc630.stl')
lid=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.07b3764e.stl')
print('jar bounds',jar.bounds,'lid bounds',lid.bounds)
# overlap z histogram
import numpy as np
v=ov.vertices
print('z min/max',v[:,2].min(),v[:,2].max())
print('r max',np.sqrt(v[:,0]**2+v[:,1]**2).max(), 'r min',np.sqrt(v[:,0]**2+v[:,1]**2).min())
# angles of overlap verts
ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(v[:,1],v[:,0]))
print('ang range',ang.min(),ang.max())
# show quantiles
for q in [0,10,50,90,100]:
    print(q, np.quantile(v[:,2],q/100))
